answer: Re-attestations are stored in marble and gale lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 4 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the walnut graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 535 impostors cost 1864 times the honest price and take 30 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
